capability: Persistent cart: the buyer's cart saved to their account, so it is still there when they switch devices (BigCommerce Persistent cart)
note: BigCommerce gives it a plan line of its own (BC-S-0084), the dry run's test for a capability: a plan line is a place of its own. The other platforms' cells come from the back-fill after BigCommerce (the coordinator, after batch 1).

capability: Shipping rules engine: a plan line naming a shipping rules engine (BigCommerce ShipperHQ shipping rules engine)
note: BigCommerce gives it a plan line of its own (BC-I-0410), the dry run's test for a capability. What the engine does is not defined in any held statement, so it can't be joined by definition to CM-SHP-004 (carrier-calculated rates) or CM-SHP-013 (rules that change delivery options); a definition, once captured, may settle a join. ShipperHQ is named only in the line's name: no statement names ShipperHQ as the engine's maker or provider. The other platforms' cells come from the back-fill after BigCommerce.
